platformScope: macOS offline diagnostic; not M4 realtime or new-scene acceptance
pixelTransfer: lossless PNG stream; no audio; no frame-image archive
foxConfiguration: bundled defaults frozen; no angle or timing changes

mediapipe.coordinateMapping: x unchanged, y=1-y; anatomical side unchanged; out-of-image points omitted
mediapipe.foxConfidenceAdapter: min(visibility,presence); not calibrated equal to Apple confidence
mediapipe.derivedJoints: neck=shoulder midpoint; root=hip midpoint; confidence=min of parent scores

appleCounter.output: raw cumulative fractional counts and window timestamps; never rounded into confirmed repetitions
appleCounter.missingPosePolicy: split sequence on absent selected pose; never carry forward coordinates
appleCounter.selection: same Fox-selected subject as candidate A; report loss separately

metrics: per-cycle matches, misses and extra events
fractional count timeline and first output window
offline inference duration, not live latency
labels: existing coarse cycle intervals unchanged; post-produced claps never enter inference
decision: diagnose next action only; no automatic model promotion, app deployment or fitness acceptance
